nom: The INKEY List SuperSolutions Blemish Clearing Moisturizer 2% Novoretin

avis.texte: I got this for acne and it has really helped. The ingredients are great for reducing blemishes and evening skin. Just make sure to get a sunscreen and yes it does have a bit of a smell but the results are worth it and it fades after application.
Works well with use, have noticed a difference, just smells so bad so definitely PM use, worth it though

This works a treat but has a very very strange smell so use sparingly. The smell is quite pungent that my husband mentioned it. The cream itself is super soft when applied and makes my skin tingle a little for a short while. I only use it when necessary, not every day.
Super strong and effective. Doesn't have the smell that other reviews talk about, so they must've changed the ingredients?

I purchased this product several months ago from the Inkey website prior to Ulta carrying this brand. Im in my late 30's and have hormonal acne, primarily on my jawline and chin/neck area. The smell doesnt bother me- i care about how effective a product is. I dont feel that this has helped clear up any acne, it has kept it from getting worse so for that I would have rated this a 4 star, however, i removed another star because this stuff pills and practically 50% of it rubs off if you have ANY kind of serum or product layered underneath. I have tried even waiting 60-90 minutes between applying my (thin) consistency vit.c serum and this moisturizer, and it doesnt matter the time, it will still pill and flake off as your rubbing it into your skin. Which probably makes it less effective since less product is actually getting absorbed. I recently purchased the moisturizer from Personal Day to try instead of this.

I've started using this moisturiser every night after my serums to try to clear my skin. Even though I still have acne scarring from before, I haven't had any new breakouts come up. Let's see whether the scarring gets cleared up as well

bought this for my 21 year old daughter who has just started having acne breakouts. Sadly she only used it once as the smell is horrible, really surprised as love Inkey products and use them extensively.

I only got this product last week and I could definitely feel a difference in the texture of my skin after the first use so I have high hopes. I probably won't purchase again as the smell is quite...pungent. This product contains sulpher so I'm assuming it's that.
Great for blemishes, I only use it at night not everyday as think it works best with my night routine

avis.titre: great for acne prone skin and sebaceous filaments
avis.texte: Yes, it has a bit of a smell but it's really not that noticeable in my opinion, especially since it's a 3% sulfur moisturizer. It's amazing on acne prone skin and sulfur also helps with minimizing the look of sebaceous filaments in addition to controlling acne. I will keep purchasing as long as they make it!
Quick to absorb, no sticky residue. Worked brilliantly on my sensitive skin. I've bought multiple of these now and will continue to buy
I bought this for my teenage daughter who suffers with minor breakouts and it really does work magic overnight. It has a slightly odd smell but is very effective at quickly reducing blemishes.

avis.titre: Makes my skin feel great but too stinky to sleep with on
avis.texte: It makes my oily skin feel lovely, but the strong burnt eggy smell is too overpowering, so I had to wipe it off. It's unfortunate as it leaves my skin feeling smooth and not oily, it's just the smell that's too strong.

avis.titre: smelt really bad and made skin irritated
avis.texte: okay so i got this because it said it may help online, so i used it, it felt like i had a oily residue all over my face and the smell was disgusting, I knew it would smell people said it would smell but it made my entire room smell of sulfur it was absolutely disgusting, I get you dont add smells to things but please if its going to smell of fart and eggs then add something! dissapointing 😨
Not a bad product but not overly amazing either. I do think I'm the wrong clientele as my breakouts probably aren't considered persistent enough. The smell is very strong

avis.titre: Great product - shame about the smell...
avis.texte: Super addition to the go-to skin care I already use, but I'm struggling with the smell... Hence the x4 stars... Is there anything that can be done about this...?? How do other users combat this issue...??

avis.titre: Can't see results yet but wanted to share
avis.texte: My skin is just about the same, I've been using it for only 2 weeks now. Just wanted to warn you guys: this cream will tarnish all your sterling silver jewellery to black. I had to polish my beloved Tiffanys twice already because I forgot to take them off (choker, earrings), it also tarnished the ring on my finger (idk how, I applied it with my fingertips and washed hands afterwards ? )

avis.titre: Amazing for breakouts face and back
avis.texte: I have been using this product for a year. I actually use it intermittently on my face as I do feel it's a bit strong, so often I might use a moisturiser before using it. However, it does work, you just need to pay attention to your skin's sensitivity. The major benefit for me has been using it on my back (using e45 moisturiser first). The has really eliminated my hormonal embarrassing back breakouts like nothing else! Within days, you notice a significant improvement, something that it's just not that common these days. I would recommend to anyone struggling with breakouts. Great product, just be mindful of its strength!
I have been struggling to find any skincare product that clears my bumps and scarring , most ones I find just smell nice and "moisturise' but this is fabulous. Results are genuinely overnight!
If you have sensitive skin like me definitely ease into using it, it's quite strong but works great!

Just cleaned my face with a gentle cleanser I have highly sensitive skin I put a pea sized amount spread over face It started burning straight away so I don't recommend it for ones with highly sensitive skin like me I had to wash it off asap
I was only able to use this once as I couldn't get passed the smell

avis.titre: Did wonders for my sister's skin
avis.texte: My sister bought it and it really helped clear up her pesky acne and she now has much clearer skin. I would definitely recommend people to try it if they have stubborn acne and nothing else helps.

I have dry acne that leaves a lot of scars and thought this product would be perfect as it's a moisturiser as well as a blemish clearer but the burning sensation on my skin was so bad that I had to scrub it off within 5 mins and my face is now very red and inflamed. The smell is also unbearable
Feels nice on my skin. Does seem to reduce appearance of spots.

I'm not sure what to think about this moisturiser. It stings when you apply it, which made me think it was working but it hasn't cleared my breakouts nor does it particularly moisturise my skin. It also smells like something has been set on fire and burnt, it ends up all over bedding and towels too... It's awful.
It's not bad actually. It works, just the sulphur discolours stuff, even my hair

I am so dissapointed. I bought this thinking it would clear my persistent breakouts, I read the reviews and thought it would work. The first time I used it my face stung a lot, turned very red and my eyes started to water, although I didn't see any improvement in my skin after a few weeks I kept at it. I then went on to buy a second bottle of this mousturiser thinking that maybe if I keep using it then I will notice some improvement. It was quite opposite. Instead I have breakouts all over my cheeks (I have never broke out there before i only used to get breakouts on my forehead) that just will not go away! The breakouts on my cheeks have really made me quite upset as that has never happened to me before. When a spot on my cheek eventually goes it leaves a really dark mark that will not go and stays ever since my spot was there. Overall I would not recommend this product as it has made my skin worse not better, I also believe that this product has damaged my skin barrier.

Hi! PCOS sufferer with all the skin concerns that come from it. Oily, breakouts, large pores and terrible texture. This took exactly 1 week to tame my hormonal acne, in combination with BHA and Phytic Acid. Keep a routine, night routine especially important!
Very good for breakouts. It's not greasy and one of the best moisturisers I've used.

This works so well, I tend to get clusters of spots (not acne) and this clears them up to the point where you can't see them under makeup, without makeup they are still visible but only slightly. They're not raised or overly red. Amazing
Haven't even had it on for an hour but already know I love it. So refreshing to find such a moisturising acne treatment! Yes it does smell a bit but so worth it.

Ruined all my jewelry that i have had for years of past family members. i am absolutely gutted, do not purchase this product because even if your not wearing your jewelry it stays on ur skin and turns your JEWELRY BLACK completely black from silver. Inkey list should write on the boxs that it turns jewelry black instead of carrying on selling this product for money when it's ruining people's stuff.

I had a couple of bad breakouts a couple of months ago so decided to try this and added to my night time routine. Took a few months but has really helped clear up my skin. It does have strong smell that isn't very pleasant and can burn a little in sensitive areas (eyes) but otherwise good product

My teenage daughter is mixed race , and has struggled with teenage acne and we've tried several products! This is a powerhouse product ! Literally overnight there was improvement and now we're really happy after using the product every night as part of her bedtime skincare routine . The acne has virtually gone !

I use this a couple of times a week and I definitely see a difference. The only issue I have is the smell. I know its due to the ingredients so I started off by using a small amount, as the directions for use recommends.

This seems to have helped my skin a lot so far, I've noticed a difference The smell is awful though, the sulfur is very obvious, if there's a way to mask that smell in the future I think the product would really benefit from it!

avis.titre: Have not seen any improvement of my acne, and still experien
avis.texte: I started this moisturiser 6 months ago, and I have not seen any improvement of my acne. My face stings every time I use it, even when using it with soothing serums and other moisturisers. It also has an odd smell due to the sulfur, it is very watery, and it pills. I recently switched to 0.1% differin gel, which is much stronger, but it doesn't cause any stinging for me. I've only recently switched, so I can't say how much more effective it is, but it is a stronger retinoid, so it should work faster. I knew this one would take longer to see results, but I thought it would be worth it if I got less irritation. If you can get access to a prescription strength retinoid like differin gel, use that instead and don't waste your time on this one

Works a treat at helping blemishes and love the fact it's a nightly treat... but smells awful! And I could still smell it on my pillows in the morning. I don't think I would continue to use this even though it works just down to the smell

Stingy when first applied with a sulfur smell (which I expected going in, so not surprised), and the product texture was less smooth than I expected. Not noticing huge results yet after 2 months, but my skin isn't reacting negatively either as I only apply to my oily T Zone (not any drier areas) aiming to combat blocked pores and blackheads.

avis.titre: IF YOU WESR SILVER JEWELLERY BE CAUTIOUS
avis.texte: I like this moisturiser it felt good on. I used it for about 4 months and didn't see much improvement but was hopeful. However since using I noticed my sliver jewellery was tarnishing alarmingly quick (like in 1/2 days). I started using it just before holiday so I thought it tarnished from the pool etc (but wasn't). After googling I found out that sulphur tarnished silver. THIS PRODUCT CONTAINS SULPHUR SO IT WILL TARNISH UR JEWELLERY. I ended up loosing a lot of earrings to this product and some sentimental gifts (necklace in particular) that are going to take a lot of work to remove the tarnish (or are just ruined).
Stings a little when you first apply but only lasts seconds. Not to keen on the smell but the product itself really works. Feels smooth once product dries and can see a difference in the morning.

Used as instructed and over the moon after first time using the moisturiser. My skin is smooth and visibly better. I'm really happy with the cream HOWEVER...... it's absolutely stinks of ammonia!!! It's a very strong smell, you can't get away from it sadly, even my partner could smell it when we are led in bed. The positives out weigh the negatives however and I will be using it as part of my weekly skin routine and really pleased with the first use results

avis.titre: Made me breakout when I had great skin
avis.texte: It cost me a lot of research and self-convincing to try out this product. As others have noted the smell is so strong that it affected me for days. I used this product once and woke up with severe pustules on my face. It was burning, red and felt like sandpaper. I have never in my life experienced something like this although I have tried many products. I went back to boots and they said they cannot refund me if I developed an allergic reaction? I do not have sensitive or acne prone skin. This has been a shocking experience and now I am forced to spend more money on products the remedy this. I feel uncomfortable leaving my house because my face is completely ruined.
Really nice moisturiser. Feels smooth on my face and does what it says. Excellent
This cream worked MIRACLES for my hormonal acne! It does smell a wee bit funky and it tingles/stings a bit when it goes on, but I wake up with almost perfectly clear skin when I have used this!

I'm 40 and I have hormone acne. I don't usually leave reviews but this product is the only thing I've used that shows results very quickly! I read other reviews about it stinging and I was worried as my skin is sensitive. The stinging and the fact the cream smells like hair perm is well worth the results. It didn't dry my skin, it's was soft the next day and my acne was more settled. It says you shouldn't use it every day until your skin gets used to it so I've been using just on my acne areas and after using it 4 times for the first time in years I've woken up today with a clear face!! Not one spot! I can't believe it! I've been cleaning with hyaluronic face wash then used hyaluronic serum then this cream at night.

I wanted to love this product as I love this brand but this product is very harsh I found. I did a patch test on my hand which I seemed to be ok with but using it on my face immediately my skin was burning and I had to remove the moisturiser.
I wanted to love this product but I found it quite harsh. I came out in a rash the next morning but maybe my skin is too sensitive for this product.
This burns real bad but my god does it work! My spots were all either gone or close to gone by morning. I still use Korean skincare alongside inkey list to get anti aging plus anti acne. Win win!

This moisturiser I had high hopes for and it didn't disappoint. It is very strong so I followed the instructions to start using it gradually and now I can use nightly. Very little is needed every night, the smell soon disappears and while it can burn to start with, as you get to nightly use it really doesn't burn it just tingles a bit. However the difference I've seen using this along with the face wash, hydrator, 20% niacinamide excess solution and moisturiser has been really amazing. Spots reduce and dry out significantly overnight. I have seen a massive improvement in my skin, it's frankly more than I ever thought was possible.

This moisturiser is absolutely amazing! I never write reviews really, but I felt like I had to share my experience. I used my salicylic acid cleanser and followed with the hyaluronic acid serum and then applied this before going to bed. As others have mentioned, it does have a strange scent but nothing you can't deal with, and it did sting a little when I first put it on, but not painful. It's also wuite sticky when lying in the pillow, so best to do half an hour or so before bed to allow it to sink in. When I woke up in the morning, I couldn't believe how fresh my skin looked. My skin was honestly glowing and visibly clearer. I have now used it several times and people have commented that my skin is looking good and asked what I've done. I've struggled with my skin since I can remember and never found anything that would help. Thank you Inkey List for this product. Its honestly changed my perception of myself - I look in the mirror and feel great. Completely changed my life. As long as you're willing to be consistent with your routine, I'd recommend to anyone who is struggling.
I noticed a difference after first use, it stung/tingled a bit but my skin was visibly clearer in the morning. I'll review in 3 months ish
If you're new to retinol this is a great starter product, clears blemishes and smooths skin quickly.

avis.titre: Great product so far but does have a strong sent

avis.titre: Great option for breakout prone skin

Instead, my skin feels smooth, plump, and oh-so-happy! I must mention that my skin can be a bit sensitive, but the Revolutionary Blemish Clearing Moisturizer has been nothing but gentle and kind. There's no fragrance to worry a

Product gifted by the INKEY list. I have been using this night cream for a couple of weeks now. My skin is acne prone, combination and sensitive, therefore I am always hesitant when trying new products. When using this product, it is best to start slow and build the frequency of use. This is to prevent any irritation or flare ups. Personally, I really like this product. It has made my skin clearer and brighter and has already started to reduce some of my pigmentation from previous acne break outs. It's worth a try.

This product was gifted by the Inkey List in exchange for my honest review. I have been impressed with the results that I have seen in my skin after just three weeks. The lotion is gentle on my skin and does not cause any irritation or dryness. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Amazing for clearing up the skin!
avis.texte: Gifted by the Inkey List. I have been using the Blemish Clearing Moisturiser for around 1-month now and I am loving the results so far and really seen a difference to the reduced amount of breakouts especially that I wear makeup almost every day. I have even found lately a bit more confidence in heading out for the day without wearing any foundation which is quite amazing for me. I started off with the recommended use of starting slowly and building up so decided to use initially every 3/4 days and then to eventually everyday and I only done that within the first two weeks but by the second week, I had reduced this to every second and then almost every day by the time into the third week. It is recommended to use a pea size amount and although it does spread well, I did find myself using a little more than that but with 50ml, there is definitely plenty to last. I didn't really like the scent of it and it is hard to describe but sort of seemed chemically to me but it didn't last that long so wasn't enough to make me stop using it. I will say that it can make your skin sting a little which is probably why it is advised to start using slowly but again, this was very brief and gave me no reactions by the time I woke up next day. The amazing thing is I already started to see some results by end of week two but not only is it good for clearing breakouts, I can also help with texture by week 12 so I cannot wait to see how better my skin is going to be. I have always loved Inkey List

The Revolutionary Blemish clearing moisturiser 2% Novoretin has smoothed my skin texture and it keeps my skin hydrated. Not only does it reduce redness overnight, it also keeps blemishes at bay. Overall I would recommend this product for those with oily skin types that need help with breakouts. This product was gifted to me by Inkey List

My skin is leaning towards oily and I have suffered with breakouts since teenage age. Gifted by the Inkey List I was extremely sceptical at first how this product could possibly reduce the redness of my blemishes overnight, but oh my!!! It really does work!! I'm hopeful to see how well this works after a few more weeks. For the money, it's well worth it!! Affordable skincare for the win!!

avis.titre: I like it but the scent is too strong
avis.texte: As someone with combination skin, I've always had periodic breakouts that were either brought on by pollutants, occasionally by lifestyle and occasionally just by hormones. And I've always tried to treat it by utilising acne-specific creams, which just served to aggravate the spots. I started using the product around two months ago after receiving it complimentary from TheInkeyList for testing purposes. I should note that I have taken retinol in the past, so my skin is already somewhat accustomed to it. As stated on the label, if this is your first time using the product, you should start by performing a patch test because the product is not meant for delicate or easily irritated skin. The primary components of the product are Novoretin at a concentration of 2%, Stay C 50 at a concentration of 5%, sulphur at a concentration of 3% (thus the odour), and retinoil at a concentration of 0.02%. It is only meant for usage at night because it contains retinol, and the next day you must apply SPF or you risk developing pigmentation marks on your face. I really appreciate how readily the lotion is absorbed, and the texture is pleasant. When applied to the face, it causes a tingling feeling that eventually goes away. For its intended uses, I truly enjoyed the product, and I believe it is functioning. However, the fragrance usually turns me off a little. Given that it contains sulphur, the scent was expected to be this way. Overall, I like it.

After about a month and a half of utilizing The INKEY List Blemish Clearing Moisturiser 2% NovoRetin, I began to notice effects. Because the product is retinoid-based, very little amounts are needed. For my own combination complexion, I apply a pea-sized amount every two to three days, and the effects are incredible: the blemishes have lessened, and the skin appears smoother. I've used different treatments in the past to treat the zits that come and go, but occasionally I made them worse because the other creams dried up my face too much. The moisturizer's texture is quite light, and it absorbs quickly into the skin. When applied to the face, it does cause a tingling feeling, but this is how it functions. Please take note that you must begin using retinol products gradually and without a doubt conduct a patch test first if you have never done so. I should mention that it contains sulfur, so don't expect it to smell like roses when it comes to scent. Even while the aroma is initially extremely strong, it will eventually disappear. I really enjoy it overall. The product is complimentary from TheInkeyList.

I was gifted by The Inkey List. I've been trying this product on and off for a while now and it just doesn't work for my skin! I can imagine it being a really great product but I just react to this, even when I've tried to gradually start using it! I will be passing this on to someone else to use!

Lates 30's with mild but persistent acne - purchased this last week and wish I had taken before and after pics. From 2 uses - the breakout on my chin and cheeks has visible reduced, no new spots have appeared and the redness and swelling has gone down loads, the overall texture of my skin already feels smoother- so excited to see what a few more weeks using this could do for me. Extremely happy customer will 100% be part of my weekly routine now.

I received this product complimentary from the brand. It's good to try this product slowly over time and get used to it as it's rather strong. Especially if you have more sensitive skin. Overall it really helped me to reduce the blemishes and dark spots and achieve a clearer skin thanks to the active ingredients. It kept my skin moisturised as well.

I have combination skin and have suffered with blemishes for a while and this is my new favourite evening moisturiser now. Make sure to patch test if you've never used retinols before and also make sure to wear spf the next day . I've started using this moisturiser almost 2 months ago and I'm very happy with the results so far . The texture is nice and creamy and absorbs well leaving slightly sticky feeling which is ok to me for overnight moisturiser. There might be slight tingling sensation at first aplication. At first use twice a week and slowly increase to every evening. This moisturiser is to be used as part of my evening skincare routine after I've cleansed my face I add pea sized amount of the product to my skin. My skin feels much smoother and blemishes have significantly reduced so far. My skintone is visibly more even and skin texture improved. If you have blemishes then you should definitely give this moisturiser a go . I received this product Complimentary from The Inkey list in exchange for my honest review.

This blemish clearing moisturiser is fantastic. I like everything about it. Make sure you patch test at first use . My skin looks a lot brighter and my blemishes are visibly reduced . I received this product as complimentary from The Inkey list.

I made a big order including this blemish, clearing moisturiser and I've loved everything except this moisturiser because it has stung, and burnt my face, but also left redness the next couple days also. This was gifted by the Inkey list. I've been using this product for almost 4 weeks now and I have seen a difference. My dark spots have reduced even more than last week. Will definitely be purchasing again.

I recieved this product gifted by theinkeylist in exchange for my honest review. I would highly reccomend building your skins tolorance up before using every day but you REALLY start to see results quite fast. My skin feels smoother, clearer and virtually blemish free. LOVE and this will be a perm product in my skincare routine.

I am happy I had opportunity to try out this fantastic moisturiser. It really helped to decrease amount of blemishes on my face. This moisturiser contains Retinol, Sulfur and other active ingredients to help improve skin condition, even out skin tone, gently exfoliate, reduces blemishes. This product provides amazing results during the night Complimentary from The Inkey List

Complimentary from The Inkey List I have recently had the chance to try The Inkey List Blemish Clearing Moisturiser with 2% Novoretin, and unfortunately, my experience with this product was far from pleasant. Initially, I was excited to try it due to its promising claims, but the results were highly disappointing. First and foremost, the scent of this moisturizer was truly off-putting. The smell was not only unpleasant but also lingered on my face throughout the day. It was quite overpowering and left me feeling uncomfortable and self-conscious. Beyond the scent issue, using this moisturizer resulted in an intense burning sensation on my skin. As soon as I applied it, I could feel a tingling and stinging sensation, which was extremely uncomfortable. Naturally, I stopped using it immediately to avoid any further skin irritation. Since different products work differently for each individual, it is essential to understand that what might not suit me personally could work for others. However, this particular moisturizer did not meet my expectations at all, and I cannot recommend it based on my own experience. I must emphasize that skincare products can have varying effects on different people, so it's important to conduct a patch test before using them extensively. Nevertheless, the combination of a foul smell and a burning sensation on my face made it impossible for me to continue using the cream. Remember, what works for one person may not work for another, so always prioritize

I've been gifted this moisturiser to try and review and omg my skin!!! I've been struggling with blemishes on my chin since forever and after just 3 weeks of using this cream they're gone! I did had a little bit of a tingling sensation in the first few days but my sensitive skin didn't feel irritated after so I totally recommend it

Kindly gifted by the inkey list in exchange for an honest review. Works great on sensitive skin and is affordable. This works to reduce blemish quickly and calms and soothes my skin. I have always found that the inkey list products have worked for my skin and are very promising. Look forward to more long term results!

I've been gifted by theinkeylist, and I love it. It hydrates all day and works as a barrier for irritation. My face looks clean and healthier than before. I've seen results in a few days, and I'm impressed! It has such a thick texture, is easy to apply, and soaks in well. Highly recommend!

A very lovely moisturiser and the retinol in the formula works great. Made my skin a little dry but that's quite normal with retinol added into products, SPF is always a must! The smell was ok but it can be quite strong if you're not used to quite chemically smells (it actually smelt like the obaji retinol but it goes away after a while and the effects of it are really good so I think it's worth it.
